label: EXPERIMENT ONLY: Top30 positive eligibility, slight Top10 bonus, unchanged Bottom50 statistical discount
rank_reference: 2026 no-preseason market-only full-period strength ranks (not recursive BetWise rank)
cutoff: Opponent ranks >30 earn zero positive competition/results/ATS credit. A smooth Top10 credit bonus ranges +10% at #1 to +1% at #10. Ranks 31-86 retain opponent-adjusted unit performance, while positive unit scores versus bottom 50 ranks 87-136 are discounted progressively 50%-100%. All negative unit performances retained.
competition_win_curve: For opponent rank 1..30: 1.5*(31-rank)/30, multiplied by 1 + .01*(11-rank) for ranks 1..10; rank>30: 0
notes: 2026 independent market ranks reflect all available 2026 lines, not strictly pregame-safe ranks.
Z-standardization can shift relative values, but positive adjusted four-unit statistics are partially discounted only for bottom-50 opponents; wins and ATS bonuses cut off outside Top30.
Market baseline retained because it measures absolute team strength, not a per-game weak-opponent bonus.
Both components containing wins are opponent quality adjusted; some overlap remains.
Frozen 2025 coefficients and 25/35/25/15 preserved. Production untouched.
